testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/login/verify-create-account-functionality.spec.ts > Webstore - Login > verify create account functionality

scenario.summary: Guest registers a new webstore account with a run-unique e-mail as username and e-mail, checks the automatic sign-in, logs out, then signs in again with the new account and checks the 'Hello,' greeting.
steps: Header Sign In; check the Create An Account button text; open /signup
Fill username and e-mail with the generated address, password and retype password; Create Account; greeting visible (auto sign-in)
Log out; Sign In link visible; sign in with the new e-mail and password; greeting contains 'Hello,'
stateChanges: Creates a NEW registered webstore account (username = e-mail = qatestaccount<Date.now()>@yopmail.com) on the store per run; the webstore has no self-serve delete and the test does no cleanup, so one account is left per run (spec note). Not torn down by TDA (created by the UI, no ledger undo)
assertions: Create An Account button has text createAccountButtonText
Greeting visible after account creation (auto sign-in)
Sign In link visible after log out
Greeting contains 'Hello,' after signing in with the new account
evidence: Title 'verify create account functionality' and the step labels (Create a new account, Log out then sign in with the new account) match the flow

No need: the account is created by the test (created-by-test), not found in the environment. The new username/e-mail is NOT a recorded literal: the spec builds it at run time as `qatestaccount${Date.now()}@yopmail.com` (template literal, not in the scan), unique per run; it is used for the username and e-mail fields and for the second sign-in

Source 2 (keyPath password, masked by key name) is the password the test SETS on the new account (create password, retype password) and then signs in with: it belongs to the created account, not to an existing one -> created-by-test (no alias; not a credential of any environment account). Value stays masked. It is a fixed recorded literal; the migrated or swapped spec may keep it (it must satisfy the store's password policy)
Source 1 'Create An Account' is the asserted button text (expected-output); source 3 'Hello,' the asserted greeting prefix (expected-output); source 0 '/' the start URL (config)

Store MaxwellsHardware: the spec runs on env.web.baseUrl (WEB_BASE_URL, webstore-z10-at), the store every migrated webstore spec runs on (same store as the approved my-account, quick-order and home-page entries)
swap: no data value (nothing to replace); the spec can stay as it is. No account is declared or leased (the test signs in only with the account it creates)
REVIEW: each run leaves a new registered account on MaxwellsHardware (yopmail address); cleanup would need an admin-side delete, out of TDA scope today
